title: UUID Generator
subtitle: Generate RFC 4122 compliant UUIDs
description: Generate RFC 4122 compliant UUIDs for unique identifiers in databases, APIs, and distributed systems. Support for different UUID versions and formats.

features.title: Multiple Versions
features.description: Support for UUID v1, v4, and others

tips: Use v4 for random UUIDs (most common)
Use v1 for time-based UUIDs when needed
Include in API responses as identifiers
